lines: Making a sound like that of a sandbag being dropped, Kageomi, who had lost his head, fell flat on the ground.
Saitou muttered, and was about to depart the scene.
It was strangely warm and slippery.
That travelled along his crotch, and fell past both legs to the ground.
The smell of blood pricked Saitou's nose.
It was not that of Kageomi, whom he had just defeated.
Saitou, who was meant to have triumphed, contorted his face.
Before he knew it, he was holding his stomach with four hands.
His suit, which had been made by his favourite tailor, was damp and stained with blood.
He had no memory whatsoever of being attacked, and yet he had sustained quite a deep wound.
He instinctively scowled at the fallen Kageomi.
Naturally, a headless corpse was hardly going to answer.
Like some kind of prank, Kageomi's headless corpse had stood up.
Furthermore, his head grew back, as if sprouting out of the opening of his neck, where it had been blown off.
「Yo, how'd you blow up my head?」
Kageomi cracked his neck joints, as if to check out the fit of his new head.
「You're not the only one whose ninja arts are a mystery, y'know?」
The battle was not over yet.
